system.description: Advanced Move. When you call upon nature to aid you against a foe, name a natural feature of your surroundings (deep roots, rocky cliffs, flowing wind, etc.) and roll+WIS.

success.label: Success!
success.value: Your foe is temporarily hampered or trapped by the feature, and you also inflict a condition on your foe.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: Your foe is temporarily hampered or trapped by the feature.
